Vendored from `https://github.com/P-p-H-d/mlib`
Commit: `d0fd65a8695218ffabf2aa543ce51ca3af69536f`

This project uses the header-only `m-lib` container macros via includes such as
`<m-lib/m-dict.h>`. The headers are vendored here so both Wii and PC builds work
without an extra machine-local dependency step.
